summary: Group-Office is a self-hosted PHP groupware/collaboration suite: users/groups/ACL permissioning, address book (contacts+organizations with per-user star and child contact/phone/email/address/date/url tables), calendar/events/participants/recurrence/alerts, tasks/tasklists, notes/notebooks, email accounts/filters/labels/aliases over IMAP/SMTP with local em_* persistence, a files module (folder tree + file records with ACL sharing, trash, versions, quotas), mail domains (postfixadmin + maildomains), CMS site/content/menu, summary announcements/rss, S/MIME certs, sync/zpush devices, custom fields engine with DDL, links/search/alerts/templates/smtp/blob core cross-cutting entities.
